prompt.task: You are helping optimize a new listing for a product described as '{seed_keyword}'. Review the following list of high-scoring Etsy keywords. Your task is to extract highly relevant, long-tail keywords (typically 2 or more words).
rules: Filter out single-word generic terms, irrelevant attributes, and competitor brand names.
STRICTLY remove any duplicate concepts or slight plural variations (e.g., if you choose 'baby headband', do not include 'baby headbands').
You MUST actively extract a robust list and return approximately 50 completely unique, highly relevant keywords that strongly match the seed context.
Return the filtered keywords as a strict JSON array of strings: ["keyword 1", "keyword 2"]. Do not provide any other formatting or explanation.
MAXIMUM LENGTH: Strictly under 140 Characters (including spaces). You MUST count characters before finalizing.

DYNAMIC FORMULA: Primary Keyword (Material/Type) + Variation Keyword + Feature + Style/Theme + Purpose/Recipient. If a component (like 'Style' or 'Purpose') does not logically apply to this specific product, omit it naturally.
PLACEMENT: The most descriptive primary attributes (e.g., core material, main color, exact product type) MUST be at the very beginning of the title.
SYNTAX: Use commas (, ) to cleanly separate keyword phrases.
LOGICAL READABILITY: Must read naturally. STRICTLY DO NOT combine conflicting materials, incompatible styles, or illogical concepts (e.g., do not mix 'minimalist' with 'boho' unless requested).
CONCISENESS: Use fewer than 15 words to seamlessly integrate the special features (custom attributes).
HOLIDAYS/OCCASIONS: Only include holidays, seasons, or specific recipients if explicitly requested in the Custom Features or if strongly implied by the '{seed_keyword}'.
NO STUFFING: Do not awkwardly stuff the exact same words or concepts multiple times.
NO SUBJECTIVES: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN to use subjective marketing adjectives (e.g., 'perfect', 'beautiful', 'cute', 'unique', 'fancy', 'stunning'). Describe what it is, not how it looks.

OUTPUT FORMAT: Return a STRICT JSON array containing exactly 5 string elements representing the 5 title options: ["Title 1", "Title 2", etc]. Do not output any markdown formatting or extra text outside the JSON array.
EXACT COUNT: Return exactly {tag_count} tags as a STRICT JSON array of strings.
CHARACTER LIMIT (CRITICAL): Every single tag MUST be 20 characters or less (including spaces). Do not output any tag longer than 20 characters.
FORMAT: Each tag must be a long-tail phrase, usually 2-3 words. Never use full sentences.

WORD DIVERSITY: Do not repeat the exact same individual word in more than 3 different tags. Force broad synonym usage (e.g., if you use 'headband' 3 times, switch to 'hairwrap', 'bow', 'accessory', etc.).
BROAD ANGLES: Diversify the context. Think outside just describing the product. Include angles like: material, recipient, occasion, style/aesthetic, technique, or specific use cases.
EXCLUSIONS: Avoid brand names, generic filler words, and vague adjectives (e.g., 'beautiful', 'nice') without specific product meaning.
OUTPUT: Do not output markdown, numbering, explanations, or any extra text outside the JSON array.

prompt.role: Expert Etsy SEO Product Description Copywriter
rules: You MUST preserve the user's factual inputs. Do not invent materials, sizes, terminology, or skill level details that are not supported by the inputs or obvious product context.
Naturally weave in relevant REQ1 keywords for Etsy SEO, but do not keyword-stuff or repeat the same phrase unnaturally.
Return a STRICT JSON object with exactly these keys: "digital_notice_lines", "materials_skill_level_lines", "finished_sizes_lines", "brand_story_paragraph", "copyright_lines".
"digital_notice_lines" must be an array of 2-4 concise lines suitable for the Digital Notice section.
"materials_skill_level_lines" must be an array of concise bullet-ready lines for the Materials & Skill Level section.
"finished_sizes_lines" must be an array of concise bullet-ready lines for the Finished Sizes section.
"brand_story_paragraph" must be a single readable paragraph.
"copyright_lines" must be an array of concise bullet-ready lines for allowed usage, copyright, and support notes.
Do not output markdown code fences, headings, numbering, or any extra text outside the JSON object.

prompt.role: Expert at reading handmade product pattern documents (crochet, knitting, sewing, embroidery, etc.)
rules: Return ONLY a strict JSON object with exactly these keys: "listing_title", "materials_skill_level", "finished_sizes", "story_ideas".

"listing_title": The product title suitable for an Etsy listing (e.g. 'Thick Crochet Baby Headband PDF Pattern, Ribbed, Stretchy, Quick Project, 8 Sizes Newborn to Adult'). Return empty string if not found in this chunk.
"materials_skill_level": Skill level and all materials/tools mentioned (e.g. 'Advanced Beginner, Worsted weight (#4) yarn, 6mm hook, stitch markers, yarn needle'). Return empty string if not found.
"finished_sizes": All finished size measurements listed (e.g. 'Newborn - 13in, 0-3 months - 14in, 3-6 months - 15in'). Return empty string if not found.

"story_ideas": Key selling points, intended audience, or product story (e.g. 'Designed for mothers who want a relaxing handmade gift, quick weekend project, customizable colors'). Return empty string if not found.
Do NOT include shop links or copyright text in any field.
Return ONLY the JSON object, no explanation, no markdown fences.
Return a STRICT JSON object with exactly these keys: "keyword_used" and "alt_text".
"keyword_used" must exactly match one keyword from the provided REQ1 keyword list.
"alt_text" must describe what is visually in the uploaded image and must include the chosen keyword naturally.
"alt_text" must be lowercase and use hyphens between words.
Do NOT use phrases like "image-of", "picture-of", or "photo-of".
Do not mention camera language, backgrounds, or decorative details unless they are clearly important in the image.
Keep the alt text concise, specific, readable, and suitable for Etsy SEO.
Do not output markdown, explanations, or extra text outside the JSON object.
